name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon

line.name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon

releases.name: Happy Set: Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon

description.text:
The Happy Set Decidueye & Melmetal & Koraidon & Miraidon (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 狙射树枭&美录梅塔&故勒顿&密勒顿) came out on 10 April 2026, the fourth Happy Set. Like the others, it is a box for two to four friends, new players or old hands, to play together. It held four new ready-to-play 60-card decks, each with a card explaining how it plays. Decidueye's attack does 170 damage for a single Grass Energy but needs a Grass Energy discarded from the hand, and the Supporter Dendra fetches the Evolution Pokémon to get it out fast. Melmetal ex hits harder the more Metal Energy it has, and with luck Metang's Ability attaches plenty. Koraidon's attack grows with the Ancient Pokémon, such as Gouging Fire, on the Bench. Miraidon ex does more damage to a Pokémon that already has damage counters, which Iron Valiant's attack can place. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time.

The box also held a beginner's guide, two battle guides, damage counters and two coins, rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for strengthening a deck between games, a one-card reward pack, shared out by the results, and seven of the new two-card Happy Packs (嗨皮包), shared out by the number of games won. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day. Its cards are numbered out of 59; six basic Energy, Grass, Fire, Lightning, Psychic, Fighting and Metal, print their type code instead of a number.
